description.value: The study investigated how cognitive reappraisal of positive and negative emotional images affects vmPFC activity and whether vmPFC activation tracks subjective and normative emotional value.

task_description.value: Participants viewed positive, negative, or neutral IAPS images and either experienced their emotions naturally or regulated them using cognitive reappraisal.

instructions.value: For the Experience condition, participants were instructed to experience their emotions naturally; for regulation, they imagined themselves as an objective observer or imagined the event as having no personal relevance to them.
